findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Employee was observed donning gloves without handwashing. PIC was made aware. Ensure that employees are aware and remember to wash their hands before donning gloves in between tasks.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.14 When to Wash. FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms as specified under § 2-301.12 immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including working with exposed FOOD, clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, and unwrapped SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and: (A) After touching bare human body parts other than clean hands and clean, exposed portions of arms; (B) After using the toilet room; (C) After caring for or handling SERVICE ANIMALS or aquatic animals as specified in 2-403.11(B); (D) Except as specified in 2-401.11(B), after coughing, sneezing, using a handkerchief or disposable tissue, using TOBACCO PRODUCTS, eating, or drinking; (E) After handling soiled EQUIPMENT or UTENSILS; (F) During FOOD preparation, as often as necessary to remove soil and contamination and to prevent cross contamination when changing tasks; (G) When switching between working with raw FOOD and working with READY-TO-EAT FOOD; (H) Before donning gloves to initiate a task that involves working with FOOD; and (I) After engaging in other activities that contaminate the hands.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.citation_text:
3-501.17 Inspector observed a series of ready to eat food items such as salads, dressings, fruits, and other condiments not properly dated and marked as required in the second walk-in cooler at the deli department. Discussed with PIC and PIC instructed employees to immediately date mark the items on the shelves. Ensure that all food items such as the one mentioned are properly dated marked at all time for safety. 

(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Date Marking. (A) Except when PACKAGING FOOD using a REDUCED OXYGEN PACKAGING method as specified under § 3-502.12, and except as specified in (E) and (F) of this section, refrigerated, READY-TO-EAT, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD prepared and held in a FOOD ESTABLISHMENT for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date or day by which the FOOD shall be consumed on the PREMISES, sold, or discarded when held at a temperature of 5C (41F) or less for a maximum of 7 days. The day of preparation shall be counted as Day 1.

findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed eggs being stored over mushrooms in the walk-in cooler in the meat department. PIC was made aware of the appropriate storage order for food items and the eggs were moved a shelf below the mushrooms in order to correct the storage order. Ensure that all food items are stored appropriately to avoid cross contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-302.11(A)(1) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (1) Except as specified in (1)(d) below or when combined as ingredients, separating raw animal FOODS during storage, preparation, holding, and display from: (a) Raw READY-TO-EAT FOOD including other raw animal FOOD such as FISH for sushi or MOLLUSCAN SHELLFISH, or other raw READY-TOEAT FOOD such as fruits and vegetables, (b) Cooked READY-TO-EAT FOOD, and (c) Fruits and vegetables before they are washed; (d) Frozen, commercially processed and packaged raw animal FOOD may be stored or displayed with or above frozen, commercially processed and packaged, ready-to-eat food.

Ensure that cold holdings are often checked to ensure they maintain the adequate temperature to avoid food spoilage.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.16(A)(2) Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Hot and Cold Holding. 4-601.11: (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent.

 6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated
findings.citation_text: 3-202.15  (Pf) Food packaging must be in good condition so that foods are not exposed to adulteration or potential contamination. Multiple cans were observed with dents in the top seams.  The PIC was consulted and the relevance of the seals were discussed. The cans were moved to another shelf for discard/credit.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.citation_text: 6-201.17  (C) Attachments to wall and ceiling such as light fixtures, mechanical room ventilation system components, vent covers, wall mounted fans, decorative items and other attachments shall be easily cleanable. Tape was observed on two of the ansil system's pipes in the hood system above the fryers. PIC was not sure what the tape was intended for. Tape had an accumulation of grease observable. The items were discussed with the PIC and the tape removed. Items appear to be functional without the tape.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment: Observed a piece of sweet ham that was dated 8/17-8/22--today is 8/28. This ham was pulled to be discarded. Date mark all time and temperature control for safety foods with the date of opening or date of preparation and hold no longer than 7 days maximum.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.17  (Pf) Date marking exceeds the time limit. Food prepared and held in a food establishment for more than 24 hours must be clearly marked to indicate the date or day by which the food must be consumed on the premises, sold, or discarded when held at a temperature of 41°F or less for a maximum of 7 days. Discussed applicable sections of 3-501.17 and reviewed HACCP concepts with person in charge. Food was discarded. Reference 3-501.17.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
1) The prep sink was separating from the wall. Reseal sink to the wall. 2) The three compartment sink was separating from the wall. Reseal sink to the wall.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed a soiled spoon stored with clean spoons at the prep area at the front of the kitchen. Spoon was removed to CORRECT the violation.
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
1) Knife folder at the back prep table was soiled with debris. Clean non food contact surface. 2) The grip/bottom area of the cold holding display was soiled with food debris. Clean non food contact surfaces. 3) The shelves underneath the breading station were soiled with food debris. Clean non food contact surfaces.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Rooms clean, lockers provided and used, clean
findings.comment:
Observed a coat stored on a food prep area. Store employee belongings in a segregated area away from food.
750-1280 Adequate area must be provided for the storage of employee belongings segregated from the food preparation and food storage area to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all employee belongings.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
Observed chipotle dip in the walk in cooler with a date mark of 6/24. Dip was immediately discarded to CORRECT the violation.
750-151(a) Refrigerated potentially hazardous food held at the establishment more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked with the ate or day by which the food shall be consumed, sold, or discarded. Maximum holding time at 41°F is 7 days. Properly date mark food and do not hold longer than 7 days.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:

750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
1) Drain cover was missing on the mop sink. Fix drain to the mop sink. 2) Drain in front of cans was soiled with debris. Clean drain.
750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
The seal on the mop sink was soiled with what appears to be mold. Clean and/or reseal mop sink to the wall.
750-1220 Walls, ceilings, and attached fixtures shall be kept clean. Clean the walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:

750-151(a) Refrigerated potentially hazardous food held at the establishment more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked with the ate or day by which the food shall be consumed, sold, or discarded. Maximum holding time at 41°F is 7 days. Properly date mark food and do not hold longer than 7 days.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
Observed a pan of lasagna in the walk in cooler with no cover. A cover was provided for the food to immediately CORRECT the violation.
750-120(a) Food shall be protected at all times. Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
Observed multiple items in the walk in cooler uncovered(cheesy hashbrowns, tator tots, etc.). Cover all food items once properly cooled.
750-120(a) Food shall be protected at all times. Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
Observed potatoes, roast, lasagna, and tator tots in walk in cooler to have no cover. Provide cover for food.
750-120(a) Food shall be protected at all times. Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: 750-690 Small sections of cardboard are being used as dividers between condiment sauces on the frontline. Cease use of cardboard. Use a material that is smooth, easily cleanable, anmd nonabsorbent. Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment: 750-850 Observed a drawer holding a mixture of pens, utensils, wrapped candies, labels, old cups, and various other possible 'junk drawer' catchall items.  Clean and organize this drawer. Drawer is located on shelf adjacent to upright freezer in back of kitchen.  Cleaned and sanitized equipment and utensils shall be handled in a way that protects them from contamination.  Spoons, knives and forks shall be touched only by their handles.  Cups glasses, bowls, plates and similar items shall be handled without contact with inside surfaces or with surfaces that contact the user’s mouth.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment: 750-1220 Floors throughout are clean. The floor beneath the plumbing lines running to the backroom handsink are observed soiled with accumulated food crumbs and soiled. Clean this hard-to-reach area. Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Toxic items properly stored
findings.comment: 750-1310 Observed a sani-bucket of 200ppm quat to be stored adjacent to cheese cutting. During the inspection, the bucket was placed on the floor. Bucket was moved to adjacent shelf where contents spilled onto a single-service box full of spoons. Bucket moved again and box cleaned. Store bucket on the floor or low shelf where contents are not going to spilled onto food, equipment, or single-service items.  All toxic items must be properly stored (i.e. segregated from food) to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all chemicals.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment:
Moist wiping cloth observed to be stored on top of counter in between uses. Store any wiping cloth in sanitizer bucket with proper concentration in between uses. CORRECTED by placing in a bucket of sanitizer.
750-810b Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
REPEAT- Observed can opener to be soiled with dried food debris. Clean and sanitize the blade at least every 4 hours when in use.
Soiled glove stored on top of food contact paper. Glove was removed and contact paper was discarded. CORRECTED.
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Water source safe, hot, and cooled under pressure
findings.comment:
Observed hot water at three pan sink to not be up to proper temperature (106 F) and needs to be at 120 F. Water heater temperature was turned up and retested and was at 120 F at the end of the inspection.
750-1030 Water under pressure at the required temperature shall be provided to all fixtures and equipment that use water.

findings.title: Lighting provided as required.  Fixtures shielded
findings.comment:
Observed light bulb in vent hood to be not working. The bulb was replaced to CORRECT the violation.
750-1230(a) Permanently fixed artificial light sources shall be installed to provide at least 20 foot-candles of light on all food preparation surfaces and at equipment or utensil washing areas.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment:
Observed mop to be stored in bucket between uses. Invert or hang mop to allow for quick drying.
750-1390 Maintenance and cleaning tools such as brooms, mops, vacuum cleaners and similar equipment shall be maintained and stored in a way that does not contaminate food.
